document.description.zh: MUYAN 创造原生于 AI 的游戏、娱乐与社交体验，让拥有个性、记忆和生命轨迹的 AI 朋友走进每个人的生活。
document.description.en: MUYAN creates AI-native games, entertainment, and social experiences—building AI friends with personality, memory, and a life of their own.

document.title.zh: MUYAN — 创造 AI 朋友

hero.eyebrow.zh: AI 娱乐 / 社交 / 游戏

hero.body.zh: 我们创造拥有个性、记忆与独立生命轨迹的 AI 朋友。
hero.body.en: We create AI companions with personality, memory, and a life of their own.

hero.beliefCard.zh: AI 会以独立个体的形式出现在未来社会，每个人都会拥有自己的 AI 朋友。
hero.beliefCard.en: AI will emerge as individuals in the society of the future. Everyone will have an AI friend.

belief.title.zh: 我们相信，AI 会以独立个体的形式出现在未来的社会中。
belief.title.en: We believe AI will emerge as individuals in the society of the future.

belief.body.zh: 每个人都会拥有自己的 AI 朋友。
belief.body.en: Everyone will have an AI friend of their own.

products.1.category.zh: AI 浪漫关系与情感陪伴

products.1.description.zh: 一个关于情感连接、鲜活角色与互动叙事的新世界，每段关系都因你而不同。
products.1.description.en: A new world of emotional connection, expressive characters, and interactive stories that feel personal.

products.1.status.zh: 预计 2026 年第四季度上线

metrics.1.detail.en: The reported annual recurring revenue result.

metrics.2.detail.zh: 星眠相关小红书内容已获得超过 100 万次浏览。
metrics.2.detail.en: The reported view total for Starry-related Xiaohongshu content.

team.label.zh: 团队 / 北京 + 上海

team.body.zh: 我们推崇信任、平等、扁平、务实的团队文化。
team.body.en: We believe in a team culture built on trust, equality, flat collaboration, and pragmatism.

accessibility.teamPhotoAlt.zh: 创意团队围桌协作的纪实画面
accessibility.teamPhotoAlt.en: A creative team collaborating around a table

contact.body.zh: 和我们一起，创造下一代 AI 游戏、娱乐与社交体验。
contact.body.en: Help us create the next generation of AI games, entertainment, and social experiences.

contact.dialog.title.zh: 来和我们一起，创造未来的朋友。
contact.dialog.title.en: Come build the next kind of friendship.

contact.dialog.body.zh: 如果你对 AI、故事、游戏，或人与智能体的新关系充满好奇，我们很想认识你。
contact.dialog.body.en: If you care about AI, stories, games, or the future of connection, we’d love to hear from you.

contact.dialog.encouragement.zh: 欢迎把简历、作品集，或一段你想创造什么的话发给我们。比起完美的自我介绍，我们更在意你的好奇心与行动力。
contact.dialog.encouragement.en: Send us your résumé, portfolio, or simply a note about what you want to create. Curiosity and conviction matter more than a perfect introduction.
